answer: Time-locked skill attestation. Each identity must complete a distinct, verifiable task sequence whose duration is fixed by physical or computational scarcity—like cultivating a juniper strain, calibrating yarrow sensors, or mapping dune migration—where results are checked against ground truth. Duplicates fail because the work cannot be parallelized or bought; an attacker pays the full wall-clock duration plus equipment per identity, making N identities cost N times the real elapsed effort rather than a one-time fee.
